name: boutique-commerce
description: Production e-commerce platform for a boutique retailer — Next.js storefront, NestJS API, PostgreSQL.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix tests ci
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:setup:test && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend:e2e: npm run db:setup:test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:e2e && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run db:seed:prod
